title: Naturality of compatible stagewise comparisons
statement: Let S be a StageSystem of categories C_i over a directed preorder I, and let F and H be functors from its pair category to any category B. For each i let e_i be a natural isomorphism between inclusion_i followed by F and inclusion_i followed by H. Suppose that for every pair A, every i above its stage and h witnessing this, F(isoToStage(A,h)) followed by e_i(A.toStage(h)) equals e_A.stage(A.obj) followed by H(isoToStage(A,h)). Then for every arrow f : A → A′, F(f) followed by e_A′.stage(A′.obj) equals e_A.stage(A.obj) followed by H(f).

source.place: PairCategory.hom_induction and mkHom_eq_isoToStage; elementary three-factor naturality argument.

proof.text: Represent f at one common stage. Factor it as the source isoToStage, the stage inclusion of the representative, and the inverse target isoToStage. The assumed compatibility is naturality of the proposed components for the source factor. Cancel the mapped target transition isomorphism in the target compatibility equation to derive naturality for its inverse. Compose those equations with the naturality of e at the representative. Associativity gives the desired equation for f.

proof_origin.place: Direct proof from the existing representative factorization and naturality of each finite-stage isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem stageComparison_naturality {I : Type*} [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I] {C : I → Type*} [∀ i, Category (C i)] {B : Type*} [Category B] (S : StageSystem C) (F H : S.PairCategory ⥤ B) (e : ∀ i, S.ι i ⋙ F ≅ S.ι i ⋙ H) (he : ∀ (A : S.PairCategory) (i : I) (h : A.stage ≤ i), F.map (S.isoToStage A h).hom ≫ (e i).hom.app (A.toStage h) = (e A.stage).hom.app A.obj ≫ H.map (S.isoToStage A h).hom) {A A' : S.PairCategory} (f : A ⟶ A') : F.map f ≫ (e A'.stage).hom.app A'.obj = (e A.stage).hom.app A.obj ≫ H.map f
